refs.quote: Alternate-Day Therapy is a corticosteroid dosing regimen in which twice the usual daily dose of corticoid is administered every other morning. The purpose of this mode of therapy is to provide the patient requiring long-term pharmacologic dose treatment with the beneficial effects of corticoids while minimizing certain undesirable effects, including pituitary-adrenal suppression,

regimens.dose_text: Administer twice the usual daily dose every other morning (time of maximal adrenal cortex activity, 2 a.m. to 8 a.m.) to minimize HPA suppression, Cushingoid effects, and growth suppression in children. If transitioning from long-term daily steroids, may require tripling or quadrupling the daily maintenance dose every other day initially.
